Airing Sunday night @ 8pm ET/PT: my latest hour-long @CNN special, “The Imperial Presidency,” examines the history of US presidential power. From Truman to Trump, that power has been expanding—well beyond what the Founders intended—and we are now in unprecedented territory 

I’ll trace that history & share my own thoughts on what such powerful presidencies mean for American democracy. Tune in to watch
Iran is no match for America. Why hasn’t Washington defeated it? washingtonpost.com/opinions/…

Ever since the Islamic regime took power in Iran, America has been of two minds about it.  

Does Washington want to change certain policies of Iran or does it want to change Iran?

After 16 consecutive years as Hungary’s prime minister, Viktor Orbán lost his re-election campaign. I spoke with historian @TimothyDSnyder about what this defeat of someone who has been a model for far-right movements around the world means for the MAGA movement and the future of liberal democracy.

Video

About six in 10 Americans disapprove of President Trump’s handling of the Iran war, while the president’s own approval ratings have hit their lowest point in his second term.

Will President Trump change course?

My conversation with @nytimes chief political analyst @Nate_Cohn:

Video

The Iran war has triggered one of the biggest supply shocks in the oil market’s history.

Why, then, does Wall Street appear so unfazed?

I asked former Goldman Sachs CEO Lloyd Blankfein, who has an excellent new memoir out called “Streetwise”:

Video

The Pentagon has announced that it will withdraw roughly 5,000 US troops from Germany — and President Trump has threatened to pull even more. What could this mean for transatlantic security?

Part 2 of my conversation with retired Admiral @stavridisj and @newamerica CEO @SlaughterAM:

Video

The war with Iran has entered its third month — and while a shaky ceasefire holds, diplomatic efforts between the US and Iran are at an impasse. What will it take to break the stalemate?
 
Part 1 of my conversation with @newamerica CEO @SlaughterAM and former NATO supreme allied commander @stavridisj:

Video

Trump’s midterm challenges with @nytimes chief political analyst @Nate_Cohn

Many senior military officials have been fired or asked to resign in the last year. How is this impacting morale within the Pentagon? I discussed with retired Navy Admiral William McRaven, author of the new book "Duty, Honor, Country & Life."
